eventPolicy.idempotency: same eventId same payload returns saved event; changed payload 409; no DDL; no additional attempt terminal state machine
eventPolicy.proof: browser passed never proves ERP success; server current source/revision and authoritative operation/readInvoiceCosts MATCH validation
eventPolicy.failurePolicy: asynchronous best effort, durable when acknowledged; explicit log-only retry, never gate/repeat business mutation
eventPolicy.preDocumentLimitation: Pre-save upload failures, matching and total-mismatch counts use INVOICE_UPLOAD_ISSUE in SystemActionLog; see import-audit-history contract. Full row evidence is saved by server preview in WebInvoiceHistory. No retrospective capture before feature deployment.
eventPolicy.freeText: forbidden; code whitelist and server-generated display only

security.access: withAuth plus active account and canManageInvoiceReceipt for logs/export
security.download: strict read-only GET, private no-store XLSX with safe filename; no export log write; response is not browser disk-save proof
security.snapshot: internal approved full snapshot only, never client editable projection; raw snapshot is not exposed in public response
security.validation: strict identifiers/current source/revision/operation/cost revision; fresh live receipt MATCH; no client amounts/formulas/paths; whitelisted stage fields/code
